Public Function Probe() As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, fc1 As Object, fc2 As Object, lo As Object, pc As Object
    Dim pt As Object, n0 As Long, s As String, v As String
    n0 = Workbooks.Count
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet): Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Range("A1:B4").Value = Application.Transpose(Application.Transpose(Array(Array("k", "v"), Array("a", 1), Array("b", 2), Array("a", 3))))
    Set fc1 = ws.Range("B2:B4").FormatConditions.Add(xlCellValue, xlGreater, "1")
    Set fc2 = ws.Range("B2:B4").FormatConditions.Add(xlCellValue, xlLess, "3")
    Set lo = ws.ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, ws.Range("A1:B4"), , xlYes)
    Set pc = wb.PivotCaches.Create(xlDatabase, ws.Range("A1:B4"))
    Set pt = pc.CreatePivotTable(ws.Range("E1"), "P1")
    pt.PivotFields("k").Orientation = xlRowField
    pt.AddDataField pt.PivotFields("v"), "Sum of v", xlSum
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = fc1.Priority & "/" & fc2.Priority
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "@@@" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    fc1.SetLastPriority: v = "done"
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "@@@" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = fc1.Priority & "/" & fc2.Priority
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "@@@" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = TypeName(lo.Slicers)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "@@@" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = lo.Slicers.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "@@@" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = TypeName(lo.Slicers.Parent)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "@@@" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = TypeName(lo.Slicers.Application)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "@@@" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = lo.Slicers.Creator
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "@@@" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = TypeName(lo.Slicers(1))
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "@@@" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = TypeName(ws.Range("F3").PivotCell.RowItems)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "@@@" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = TypeName(ws.Range("F3").PivotCell.RowItems.Parent)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "@@@" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ws.Range("F3").PivotCell.RowItems.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "@@@" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = Workbooks.Count - n0
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "@@@" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = wb.Queries.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "@@@" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = TypeName(wb.Queries.Add("Q1", "let Source = 1 in Source", "d"))
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "@@@" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = wb.Queries.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "@@@" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = wb.Queries(1).Name
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "@@@" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = wb.Queries("Q1").Formula
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "@@@" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = wb.Queries(1).Description
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "@@@" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = TypeName(wb.Queries(1).Parent)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "@@@" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = wb.Queries.Item(1).Name
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "@@@" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = wb.Queries(2).Name
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "@@@" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = TypeName(wb.Queries.Add("Q1", "let Source = 2 in Source"))
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "@@@" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    wb.Queries(1).Delete: v = "done"
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "@@@" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = wb.Queries.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "@@@" & v
    On Error GoTo 0
    wb.Close False
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
